source: GitHub (mupen64plus/mupen64plus-core issue #1069, 'Banjo-Tooie: Music goes silent in Jolly Roger Lagoon (ParaLLEl RDP)')
author: Jj0YzL5nvJ (a mupen64plus-core contributor), comment of 2025-12-30: 'For those who want to try: Banjo-Tooie-U-40E98FAA.zip'
licence: none stated (a file attached to a public GitHub issue)
what_it_is: The commenter's own Banjo-Tooie (USA) game, offered to reproduce a bug: GAME 1, TIME 18:05:18, 32 JIGGIES. One 16 Kbit EEPROM image, 2048 bytes, zip entry dated 2025-12-30 00:35.
note: Attributed to mupen64plus-core by its name: '<GoodName>-<first 8 hex digits of the ROM MD5>.eep' is the name mupen64plus-core gives its save files (the No-Intro ROM's MD5 is 40e98faa24ac...). The frontend is not stated (the commenter points users at RMG, a mupen64plus-core frontend); the core writes the file either way. The bytes are a plain EEPROM byte stream: copied unchanged into the EEPROM region (offset 0) of a Mupen64Plus-Next .srm, the game shows the file. proof.png is that check (Mupen64Plus-Next, angrylion), not a screenshot from the author.
